Indian diplomat flags incorrect map at Bangladesh event

An Indian diplomat, Pooja Kumari Jha, raised an objection at a seminar in Dhaka, Bangladesh, when a map displayed incorrectly depicted India's territory, specifically regarding Jammu and Kashmir. The diplomat asserted that Jammu and Kashmir is an integral part of India. The incident occurred during an event attended by former Bangladesh High Commissioner to India Ahmed Tariq Karim.
